maya (PM - Partnerships): Heads-up: we need to coordinate a breaking change to the inference API response schema that moves per-token metadata into a separate `token_meta` field. This affects partner SDKs, marketplace packaging, and SI integrations. Proposed public canary: 2026-05-15, deprecation window 8 weeks, final removal 2026-07-10. Who needs what notice? :megaphone:

alex (Partner Eng): Thanks — can you confirm which SDK surfaces are changed? Is this just response shape or auth flow too?

maya (PM - Partnerships): Just response shape for generation endpoints. No auth changes. SDKs that parse tokens or rely on positional token metadata will need updates.

sam (SE - HW Partner, LumenWorks): FYI our on-device SDK and batch uploader currently flattens token metadata into the token array. That is tightly coupled in firmware. We need at least 10 weeks to align QA + a minor firmware roll. 8 weeks might be tight.

beth (Legal): Per several enterprise contracts, partner-facing breaking changes require 90 days notice for certain customers. We should flag customers in that bucket and check contract clauses before public announcement.

toni (DevRel): We can prepare migration docs and a short migration snippet. Suggest adding a feature flag in the hosted API so partners can opt-in early. Can also run two code samples (old and new) in the migration guide.

devex-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging canary on 2026-05-15 10:00 UTC. Prod rollout tentative 2026-05-22 pending partner sign-off.

alex (Partner Eng): If staging canary is 5/15, partners need SDK patch + release notes at least 2 weeks before for validation. Also recommend a compatibility shim we can publish to npm/pypi that maps old shape to new for a transitional period.

sam (SE - HW Partner, LumenWorks): A shim would help. Does the shim need to live in our firmware or upstream? Ideally upstream so we don't ship firmware change for customers who don't upgrade.

maya (PM - Partnerships): Upstream shim + partner-specific integration notes. For HW partners who can't pull upgrades quickly, we'll support a managed compatibility layer for 12 weeks post-public.

toni (DevRel): Draft migration snippet for JS shim:

```js
// quick shim: if token_meta absent, synthesize from tokens array
function normalizeResponse(resp) {
  if (!resp.token_meta) {
    resp.token_meta = resp.tokens.map((t, i) => ({ index: i, score: t.score || null }));
  }
  return resp;
}
```

alex (Partner Eng): Nice. We'll publish that as `@redwood/compat-token-meta` and add basic tests. Can we commit to keeping the shim for the entire deprecation window + 4 weeks?

maya (PM - Partnerships): Yes — shim supported through 2026-08-07 (deprecation final removal 7/10 + 4 weeks).

beth (Legal): I'll review public announcement copy for required legal language and escalate any contract holdouts. We should prepare an opt-out list for customers requiring longer windows.

sam (SE - HW Partner, LumenWorks): I'll start internal impact assessment and get timelines from firmware team. Will need the shim and a sample integration test harness.

toni (DevRel): I can own the migration docs and a short video walkthrough. Suggest a joint webinar with LumenWorks week after canary (5/18-5/22) to surface common gotchas.

maya (PM - Partnerships): Action items:
- alex: publish shim package + tests by 2026-05-01
- devex-bot / infra: confirm staging canary infra and add feature flag (owner: eng-runtime)
- sam: deliver firmware impact doc by 2026-04-24
- beth: legal review + contract holdout list by 2026-04-28
- toni: migration guide draft by 2026-05-05 and webinar plan

Any blockers? :eyes: 

alex (Partner Eng): None on our side, will slot it into next sprint and ping if anything slips.

sam (SE - HW Partner, LumenWorks): The only real blocker is firmware QA time. I'll flag if we need to push canary.

beth (Legal): I'll flag any customers where legal requires longer notice.

maya (PM - Partnerships): Great — thanks all. I'll update partners/marketplace teams and draft the announcement schedule after we get the legal list.

toni (DevRel): +1, will start slides. :rocket:
